reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:b02605d985876e04b6e2ed1740cea214]] This oil diffuser is awesome! It has simple settings for continuous or intervals of misting. Not to mention the lighting freature is great. It offers to have one steady color or interchangeable. Very calming for me.
Really like diffuser. Bought for small office

[[VIDEOID:fae2d3ede5a0da1247a025825ac295da]] I love this little oil diffuser so small yet so powerful i use it in my living room and can smell it throughout the house continuous mist while color changing for 4 hours than it turns itself off.easily connects to usb charger Definatly worth the money would buy again.

[[VIDEOID:6e5fdc5685900b09a150e225f53b603a]] I bought this because of its small size to be able to fit on my nightstand. It is super quiet, works well with the essential oils I bought. I love the lights on it. Very soothing. In all, im glad I purchased it
[[VIDEOID:4d6a53dd852a68e8dfb5a0123020af77]] Very durable and easy to use. Looks beautiful. I love this essential oil diffuser.
Quiet pretty colors easy to operate and use great value for what I paid for it.

reviews.t: Do not know what recipient thought of it?
reviews.x: Was a gift and not sure about their satisfaction.

I love this little diffuser!  It is small, so can be placed almost anywhere you wish, but puts out the smell and diffuses like a large diffuser would.  This item is great for a bedroom or office.  There is no plug in cord for an outlet so it will need to be plugged into a laptop or phone charging block, etc. However, I highly recommend this diffuser.  Very easy to use and quiet noise level. The well for water and oils is large enough and made to where when taking the top off to refill, leftover

Size if perfect for my desk  Is not spill proof so you have to be careful  It lasts 3 hours of continue use, I think is great for work hours  Have lights, I like the purple  Diffuse the oils strong smell
Great product! I love the intermittent setting to constantly have my house smelling fresh and releasing calming essential oils! I just got it and I love it!

reviews.t: serves the purpose for the price
reviews.x: it isn't nearly as colorful as the picture

I was so excited to get this diffuser...it's a piece of junk that stopped working on the third day of using it and now it's just a pretty light...and to top it off the link for the free essential oil that came in the box says link can't be found lol...what a waste of money and time...do yourself a favor and purchase a different diffuser from a different seller...unless you like throwing your money away

At first I thought maybe it was a packaging error, so I requested a replacement. So now that I have received a SECOND one with NO CORD...I'm beginning to believe it doesn't come with one. Even though the paperwork inside the box CLEARLY says it is one included. I'll just pay more for one in a local store..atleast I can inspect it before buying. VERY DISAPPOINTED!

Giving this two stars because it comes with a usb cord but without a power adapter.  I ordered two and one did not work at all despite trying several adapters we already had lying around the house. Bought these as a Black Friday deal as a gift and the defect wasn’t discovered until after the return  date closed so at least the money lost was minimal.

It is truly the perfect size and works great! I have a few discrete tools I use and I love this diffuser the colors are pretty and relaxing and I find that it stays on for a good while. It also has a very fine mist which I like because it doesn’t leave anything wet. I truly do love this one and will be ordering a 2nd for another room

This is my first oil diffuser, and I am not disappointed. The product was easy to use and get setup. The color changing light really livened up my room while the oil diffused a wonderful smell throughout my apartment. Cannot wait to try more oils and enjoy this in the future. Highly recommend!

reviews.t: So nice and easy to use
reviews.x: I love this diffuser. I got it during a coupon that was advertised because I couldn't justify buying a diffuser when I've never used one. I love this one it takes in tons of different types of diffusing oil and also sprays a lot more than you'd imagine while not overdoing it.

I really enjoy the spout for the mist where it is distributed and it holds a great amount of water. I use this all day for work and do not need to refill it. I like being able to turn on the light to make it colorful or leave it off. Definitely worth the price!

reviews.t: Did not come with the plug.
reviews.x: This product didn't even come with the plug your suppose to have to plug it in. Couldn't even use it! It was a gift for someone that i bought for them well before Christmas. So once it was actually opened it was to late to return it!

reviews.t: love it, but something is wrong.
reviews.x: ive had mine for a few months now but for some reason it has stopped working. itll only turn on for 10 seconds and then turns itself off. i cant use the light mode and the mist at the same time or else it turns off immediately.

reviews.t: Great for First Time Diffuser Buyers
reviews.x: I love it so much!! I wanted a diffuser but I didn’t really want to spend too much money so I got the Natrogix it’s perfect for a first time buyer. Next time, I’ll get a bigger one but besides that everything is perfect.

I bought this diffuser for a previous Natrogix diffuser I had that had died.  I love how easy it is to use and always spreads my essential oil flavors around.  I would highly recommend this product for anyone else.

I love this little diffuser. It’s the perfect size for my side table along with my candles and zen garden. It’s super easy to use and only took seconds. I love how it also acts as a light. Highly recommend.
I used this and I was happy initially after a month or two it stopped working properly. The light does work but diffuser or steamer doesn’t work properly.4 stars for the initial performance.
[[VIDEOID:e74f37724a848cdd4b748fc03c039193]] Got it out the box and set it up. Never started working. The light worked but the mist never came out. So disappointed. Was excited to try.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the diffuser's small size, noting it fits easily on nightstands, desks, and in small offices while still being powerful enough to scent a room.
Many customers highlight the colored lights and calming, soothing effect as a favorite feature.
Users commonly describe the diffuser as easy to use and operate, with simple settings like continuous or intermittent misting.
Several reviewers complain that no power adapter or cord is included, with some reporting the unit did not work at all.
A few negative reviews mention durability problems or colors not matching the picture.
